stories.title: Cathay orders 14 more Airbus aircraft with Broughton-built wings
stories.summary: Hong Kong’s Cathay Group has ordered 14 more Airbus aircraft, adding to the order book for the Broughton factory where the company’s wings are built. stories.title: Transport for Wales cancels Chester to Liverpool Lime Street services for the day
stories.summary: Trains between Chester and Liverpool Lime Street have been cancelled for the whole of today, Wednesday 11 November. Transport for Wales said services will not run in either direction because of a shortage of its Class 197 trains. The operator said more trains than usual need repairs at the same time. stories.title: Volunteers clearing snow in Flintshire town centres must pay for salt, councillors told
stories.summary: Community groups and town councils that want to help clear snow from Flintshire’s town centre pavements have to pay the county council for salt, councillors have been told. stories.title: Two in three people don’t find Flint welcoming, council consultation finds
stories.summary: Placemaking plans for Flint and Mold, the last of seven for Flintshire’s towns, have been backed by councillors.

stories.title: More than 2,000 Welsh veterans in hidden homelessness, Senedd Member claims
stories.summary: More than 2,000 military veterans in Wales fall into the covert category of homelessness, a Senedd Member has claimed during First Minister’s Questions.
